passage: The school committee met for two hours to discuss the proposed later start time. At the end of the meeting, the committee announced ______ decision to the parents who had attended.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: "Committee" acts as a single unit here, so it takes a singular pronoun.
"It's" means "it is"; "there" is a place word; "their" is plural.
key: Collective nouns acting as one unit take singular pronouns: its.
